"""Root-only proposal. Do not invoke until independent review and committed release."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
PROBE = Path("docs/reviews/probes/r139_integrated_20261021/native_operational_20261024")
RUNTIME = Path(".cvf/runtime/r139_v3_coord_recovery_20261026")
DESIGN = PROBE / "reentry_activation_boot_identity_v3_design.py.txt"
DESIGN_SHA256 = "36f5f30777938224a6d3daf0d50b452a466ffcd4dc77f2a9e5b8e0a4ef9e241d"
BUILD_PATH = "CVF_SESSION/authority/CCMAI-RUNTIME-139-V3-ACTIVATION-ENV-ACCEPTED-BUILD-PINS-ADMISSION.json"
BUILD_SHA256 = "ad34819637bb2875098f5fb9cc6cf40e915361b097c8c28aaa30b8b1310df25b"
V3_GRANT_SHA256 = "78ae94c663cb2de1484c79da0efed6382cbf85c6bc1d791d208f87358b02cc0f"
RECOVERY_PATH = "CVF_SESSION/authority/CCMAI-RUNTIME-139-COORD-OWNER-RECOVERY-ADMISSION.json"
RECOVERY_SHA = "c6580693da837b014ac8356d3ceaf7b1317ba4970ed6a5d05c1859327d6d2431"
REVIEW_PATH = "docs/reviews/R139_COORD_RECOVERY_G0_TECHNICAL_REVIEW_2026-10-26.md"
PRIOR_WAIT_PATH = (PROBE / "v3_coord_owner_hold_20261026/original_wait_exit.json").as_posix()
OWNER_METADATA_PATH = (PROBE / "coord_recovery_coordination_owner_20261026.json").as_posix()
NONCE = "4f37f37b37fa5295611c84b63d1d9910"
READY = ".cvf/runtime/r139_v3_coord_recovery_20261026_readiness"


def unique_object(pairs):
    result = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise RuntimeError("DUPLICATE_METADATA_KEY")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def strict_json(raw):
    return json.loads(raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_object)


def verify_actual_owner_and_supplement(recipe, build):
    if recipe.get("coordRecoveryAdmissionRef") != {"path": RECOVERY_PATH, "sha256": RECOVERY_SHA}:
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_SUPPLEMENT_REF")
    supplement_raw = (ROOT / RECOVERY_PATH).read_bytes()
    if sha(supplement_raw) != RECOVERY_SHA:
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_SUPPLEMENT_SHA")
    supplement = strict_json(supplement_raw)
    if (supplement.get("ownerApproved") is not True or
            supplement.get("kind") != "OWNER_APPROVED_R139_COORD_OWNER_RECOVERY_ADDITIONAL_PRECLOCK" or
            supplement.get("sharedFutureControllerUsedBefore") != 1 or
            supplement.get("sharedFutureControllerTotalCap") != 2 or
            supplement.get("additionalOriginalControllerInvocationMax") != 1 or
            supplement.get("retryOldInvocationOrPaths") is not False or
            supplement.get("nonce") != NONCE or
            supplement.get("sourceCommit") != build["sourceCommit"] or
            supplement.get("acceptedBuildPinsRef") != {"path": BUILD_PATH, "sha256": BUILD_SHA256}):
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_SUPPLEMENT_BOUNDARY")
    expected_roots = {"controllerRoot": RUNTIME.as_posix(), "readinessRoot": READY,
        "childLogRoot": ".cvf/runtime/r139_v3_coord_recovery_20261026_activation_logs",
        "recorderRoot": ".cvf/runtime/r139_v3_coord_recovery_20261026_recorder"}
    if supplement.get("freshRoots") != expected_roots:
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_PATH_CONTRACT")
    coord = READY + "/coordination"
    if (recipe.get("nonce") != NONCE or recipe.get("coordinationRoot") != coord or
            recipe.get("childLogRoot") != expected_roots["childLogRoot"] or
            recipe.get("reservationPath") != READY + "/campaign_reservation.json" or
            recipe.get("signalPath") != coord + "/root_g0_release.json" or
            recipe.get("failurePath") != coord + "/activation_failure.json"):
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_RECIPE_IDENTITY_PATHS")
    if (ROOT / expected_roots["childLogRoot"]).exists() or (ROOT / expected_roots["recorderRoot"]).exists():
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_EFFECT_ROOT_OCCUPIED")
    for rel in (recipe["reservationPath"], recipe["signalPath"], recipe["failurePath"]):
        if (ROOT / rel).exists():
            raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_SIGNAL_OR_RESERVATION_OCCUPIED")
    coord_dir = ROOT / coord
    if not coord_dir.is_dir() or {p.name for p in coord_dir.iterdir()} != {"owner.json"}:
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_COORD_EXCLUSIVE")
    owner_raw = (coord_dir / "owner.json").read_bytes()
    owner = strict_json(owner_raw)
    metadata_raw = (ROOT / OWNER_METADATA_PATH).read_bytes()
    owner_ref = {"path": OWNER_METADATA_PATH, "sha256": sha(metadata_raw)}
    if (owner_raw != metadata_raw or recipe.get("coordinationOwnerMetadataRef") != owner_ref or
            recipe.get("coordinationOwnerSha256") != sha(owner_raw)):
        raise RuntimeError("ACTUAL_OWNER_BYTE_BINDING")
    expected_owner = {"kind": "R139_ROOT_PRECLOCK_COORDINATION_OWNER", "trancheId": "CCMAI-RUNTIME-139",
        "nativeContractId": recipe["nativeContractId"], "nonce": NONCE,
        "owner": "Root original-control custodian", "sourceCommit": build["sourceCommit"],
        "acceptedBuildSha256": BUILD_SHA256, "rootExclusive": True,
        "freshGrantSha256": recipe["freshGrant"]["sha256"],
        "coordRecoveryAdmissionRef": {"path": RECOVERY_PATH, "sha256": RECOVERY_SHA},
        "currentlyReserved": False, "effectAuthority": "OWNERSHIP_METADATA_ONLY_NOT_EFFECT_RELEASE"}
    if owner != expected_owner or owner.get("rootExclusive") is not True or owner.get("currentlyReserved") is not False:
        raise RuntimeError("ACTUAL_OWNER_FULL_SCHEMA_IDENTITY")
    config = ROOT / READY / "docker_config/config.json"
    if config.read_bytes() != b"{}\n":
        raise RuntimeError("DOCKER_CONFIG_CONTRACT")
    prior_raw = (ROOT / PRIOR_WAIT_PATH).read_bytes()
    prior = strict_json(prior_raw)
    prior_ref = {"path": PRIOR_WAIT_PATH, "sha256": sha(prior_raw)}
    if (recipe.get("priorOriginalWaitExitRef") != prior_ref or
            prior.get("pid") != 23500 or prior.get("originalWaitReturned") is not True or
            type(prior.get("exitCode")) is not int or prior["exitCode"] != 1):
        raise RuntimeError("PRIOR_ORIGINAL_EXIT_NOT_RETAINED")
    if recipe.get("cumulativeControllerAccounting") != {"usedBefore": 1, "totalCap": 2, "additionalMax": 1, "usedAtIntent": 2}:
        raise RuntimeError("CUMULATIVE_CONTROLLER_ACCOUNTING")
    review_ref = recipe.get("coordRecoveryTechnicalReviewRef", {})
    if review_ref.get("path") != REVIEW_PATH:
        raise RuntimeError("CURRENT_RECOVERY_REVIEW_PATH")
    review_raw = (ROOT / REVIEW_PATH).read_bytes()
    if sha(review_raw) != review_ref.get("sha256") or b"Status: REVIEW_PASS" not in review_raw[:320]:
        raise RuntimeError("CURRENT_RECOVERY_REVIEW_NOT_ACCEPTED")
    if (recipe.get("readyForActivation") is not True or recipe.get("canonicalTemplatesStatus") != "SEALED" or
            recipe.get("rootSealPending") is not False or recipe.get("oldResourceExclusionReviewed") is not True):
        raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_SEAL_NOT_COHERENT")
    for rel, expected_sha in recipe["oldSha256"].items():
        if sha((ROOT / rel).read_bytes()) != expected_sha:
            raise RuntimeError("ROOT_PREEXTRACTION_CANON_DRIFT")
    for rel, expected_sha in recipe["protectedUnchangedHashes"]["files"].items():
        if sha((ROOT / rel).read_bytes()) != expected_sha:
            raise RuntimeError("ROOT_PREEXTRACTION_PROTECTED_DRIFT")
    return {"ownerRef": owner_ref, "supplementSha256": RECOVERY_SHA,
        "previousOriginalExitRef": prior_ref, "currentReviewRef": review_ref,
        "fullOwnerSchemaMatches": True, "coordinationOwnerOnly": True,
        "verifiedBeforeControllerExtractionAndBootQuery": True, "effectsObserved": 0}



def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def now():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(timespec="microseconds")


def put_new(folder, name, data):
    with (folder / name).open("xb") as file:
        file.write((json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))


def git_read(git_binary, *args):
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items()
           if not key.upper().startswith("GIT_")}
    result = subprocess.run([git_binary, *args], cwd=ROOT, env=env,
                            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True,
                            shell=False, timeout=10, check=False)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("GIT_PREFLIGHT_FAILED")
    return result.stdout


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 4:
        raise RuntimeError("ROOT_CUSTODY_ARGS")
    if not (ROOT / ".cvf/manifest.json").exists():
        raise RuntimeError("PROJECT_CWD_REQUIRED")
    recipe_rel, recipe_sha, dispatch_head = sys.argv[1:]
    if recipe_rel != (PROBE / "coord_recovery_activation_recipe_20261026.json").as_posix():
        raise RuntimeError("RECIPE_SCOPE")
    raw = (ROOT / recipe_rel).read_bytes()
    if sha(raw) != recipe_sha:
        raise RuntimeError("RECIPE_SHA")
    recipe = json.loads(raw)
    if recipe.get("kind") != "R139_ROOT_ACTIVATION_RECIPE" or recipe.get("status") != "COMMITTED_PRECLOCK":
        raise RuntimeError("NOT_SEALED")
    if recipe.get("acceptedBuildPinsRef") != {"path": BUILD_PATH, "sha256": BUILD_SHA256}:
        raise RuntimeError("BUILD_REF")
    if recipe.get("bootV3Admission", {}).get("sha256") != V3_GRANT_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("V3_GRANT")
    build_raw = (ROOT / BUILD_PATH).read_bytes()
    if sha(build_raw) != BUILD_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("BUILD_SHA")
    build = json.loads(build_raw)
    if (build.get("kind") != "ROOT_REVIEWED_R139_ACCEPTED_BUILD_PINS" or
            build.get("rootReviewApproved") is not True or
            build.get("sourceChecksAccepted") is not True or
            build.get("sourceCommit") != "7ef30823746d72e935607c0bebf6ab306099eb48"):
        raise RuntimeError("BUILD_NOT_ACCEPTED")
    metadata_validation = verify_actual_owner_and_supplement(recipe, build)
    python_pin = build["pins"]["tools"]["python"]
    python = Path(python_pin["path"])
    py_raw = python.read_bytes()
    if len(py_raw) != python_pin["size"] or sha(py_raw) != python_pin["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("PYTHON_PIN")
    if Path(sys.executable).resolve() != python.resolve():
        raise RuntimeError("CUSTODIAN_PYTHON_PIN")
    source = (ROOT / DESIGN).read_bytes()
    if sha(source) != DESIGN_SHA256 or build["pins"]["sourceSha256"].get(DESIGN.as_posix()) != DESIGN_SHA256:
        raise RuntimeError("CONTROLLER_PIN")
    controller_rel = RUNTIME / "activation_controller.py"
    if recipe.get("invocation", {}).get("controllerScriptPath") != controller_rel.as_posix():
        raise RuntimeError("CONTROLLER_SCOPE")
    controller = ROOT / controller_rel
    if controller.exists():
        raise RuntimeError("CONTROLLER_ALREADY_EXTRACTED")
    if len(dispatch_head) != 40 or any(c not in "0123456789abcdef" for c in dispatch_head):
        raise RuntimeError("DISPATCH_HEAD_FORMAT")
    git_pin = build["pins"]["tools"]["git"]
    git_binary = git_pin["path"]
    git_raw = Path(git_binary).read_bytes()
    if len(git_raw) != git_pin["size"] or sha(git_raw) != git_pin["sha256"]:
        raise RuntimeError("GIT_BINARY_PIN")
    if git_read(git_binary, "rev-parse", "HEAD").decode("ascii").strip() != dispatch_head:
        raise RuntimeError("HEAD_DRIFT")
    if git_read(git_binary, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all", "-z"):
        raise RuntimeError("WORKTREE_DIRTY")
    if git_read(git_binary, "show", "HEAD:" + recipe_rel) != raw:
        raise RuntimeError("RECIPE_NOT_COMMITTED")
    if git_read(git_binary, "show", "HEAD:" + DESIGN.as_posix()) != source:
        raise RuntimeError("DESIGN_NOT_COMMITTED")
    # The reviewed controller itself checks the exact clean HEAD, committed refs,
    # all pins, fresh ownership, clock bracket and Root's technical review.
    for binding_path in (RECOVERY_PATH, REVIEW_PATH, OWNER_METADATA_PATH, PRIOR_WAIT_PATH):
        if git_read(git_binary, "show", "HEAD:" + binding_path) != (ROOT / binding_path).read_bytes():
            raise RuntimeError("RECOVERY_BINDING_NOT_COMMITTED")
    custody = ROOT / RUNTIME / "control_outer"
    custody.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
    put_new(custody, "metadata_verified_before_extraction.json", metadata_validation)
    with controller.open("xb") as file:
        file.write(source)
    argv = [str(python), "-B", str(controller), recipe_rel, recipe_sha, dispatch_head]
    put_new(custody, "intent.json", {
        "kind": "ROOT_ORIGINAL_CONTROL_POPEN_CUSTODY_COORD_RECOVERY",
        "argv": argv, "cwd": str(ROOT), "createdAtUTC": now(),
        "noRetry": True, "sharedFutureControllerAdditionalCap": 1,
        "sharedFutureControllerAdditionalUsedAtIntent": 1,
        "historicalPid24484Exit1Retained": True,
        "priorController23500Exit1Retained": True,
        "sharedFutureControllerTotalCap": 2, "sharedFutureControllerUsedAtIntent": 2,
        "coordRecoveryAdmissionSha256": RECOVERY_SHA,
        "v2ReleaseSupersededDisabled": True,
        "v3GrantSha256": V3_GRANT_SHA256,
        "designSha256": DESIGN_SHA256,
    })
    with (custody / "stdout.bin").open("xb") as out, (custody / "stderr.bin").open("xb") as err:
        process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=ROOT, shell=False, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                                   stdout=out, stderr=err)
        put_new(custody, "started.json", {
            "pid": process.pid, "originalPopenReturned": True,
            "startedAtUTC": now(), "startedMonotonic": time.monotonic(),
        })
        exit_code = process.wait()
    put_new(custody, "original_wait_exit.json", {
        "pid": process.pid, "originalWaitReturned": True, "exitCode": exit_code,
        "returnedAtUTC": now(), "returnedMonotonic": time.monotonic(),
    })
    raise SystemExit(exit_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
